title: Drone Hero
description:
• Feel like the world's best drone pilot.

• People say they love the steering.

• 25 challenges with increasing difficulty.

• Local pass-and-play multiplayer, great for parties.

• Designed for VR but can also be played on a regular screen with keyboard or gamepad.
CREATED WITH LOVE BY NEUSTONNeuston is a game studio that focuses on creating super-tight action games.SEIZURE WARNINGA small percentage of people may experience a seizure when exposed to certain visual images, including flashing lights or patterns. Immediately stop playing and consult a doctor if you experience any symptoms.
description_short: Feel like the world's best drone pilot! Designed for VR but also supports a regular screen with keyboard/gamepad.
